source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Characteristics of Successful Entrepreneurs under 9.4 as printed (PDF 131, printed 127).

blocks.text: Successful entrepreneurs are creative and always look for new ideas to solve problems. They are hardworking and remain committed to achieving their goals. Good entrepreneurs are confident and willing to take calculated risks. They have strong decision-making and problem-solving skills. They are also adaptable and can adjust to changing market conditions and customer needs.
